display_name: Kumaragupta I as Shakraditya of Nalanda
one_line: Gupta emperor and patron whose reign saw the Nalanda monastery complex take shape amid a plural seal‑maker milieu.

appearance.age_look: Mid-30s, lean yet regal build, athletic rather than bulky.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, wheatish Magadha complexion, straight nose, sharp brows, a small neatly trimmed moustache, calm focused eyes, default expression a composed half‑smile showing thoughtful confidence.
appearance.hair: Dark brown-black hair, medium length, combed back from the forehead and tied into a short, neat topknot; front has a smooth, slightly wavy fringe pushed upward; wears a simple golden circlet diadem with a tiny central lotus motif, close-fitting and understated.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate Gupta royal costume: an ivory-white fine cotton uttariya draped over the left shoulder and across the chest like a shawl, paired with a deep maroon silk dhoti wrapped tightly from waist to ankle with a distinctive broad border in gold and dark green; the dhoti is pleated in front in a clean V-shaped fall; torso modestly covered by the uttariya and an under-tunic in pale beige; feet in simple brown leather sandals; jewellery limited to a short gold necklace of flat plaques, two slim gold armlets on upper arms with scrollwork, and a pair of small gold stud earrings; no heavy armor, only a narrow fabric kamarband (waistband) in dark green with subtle repeating wave pattern, from which a small pouch for seals hangs at his right hip; overall cloth surfaces are plain or lightly patterned, without later-era embroidery.
appearance.signature: A palm-sized clay seal tablet held in his left hand, showing in relief a seated, fully robed figure beneath an arch with a short Brahmi inscription band, while his right hand rests on a simple wooden tray containing several freshly pressed oval clay seals; this seal set is his constant prop symbolizing Nalanda’s plural patronage rather than a weapon.

ref_desc: A mid-30s wheatish Gupta emperor with oval face, short topknot hair and gold circlet, wearing ivory uttariya, maroon dhoti with dark green-gold border, modest necklace and armlets, and holding a clay seal over a wooden tray of seals in ivory, maroon, dark green, gold, and warm brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of a mid-30s Gupta emperor with a wheatish Magadha complexion, oval face, high cheekbones, sharp brows, small moustache, and calm thoughtful half-smile. His dark brown-black hair is combed back into a neat short topknot, with a smooth raised fringe and a simple gold circlet diadem featuring a tiny lotus at the center. He wears an ivory-white fine cotton uttariya draped over his left shoulder and across his chest over a pale beige under-tunic, and a deep maroon silk dhoti wrapped tightly from waist to ankle with a broad dark green and gold border and clean front pleats. A narrow dark green waistband with a subtle wave pattern circles his waist, holding a small pouch for seals at his right hip. He has a short gold plaque necklace, slim gold armlets on both upper arms, and small gold stud earrings, with brown leather sandals on his feet. In his left hand he prominently holds a palm-sized clay seal tablet showing a robed seated figure and inscription band, while his right hand rests near a simple wooden tray containing several freshly pressed oval clay seals, emphasizing him as patron among seal makers. Show him from multiple angles but keep the same ivory, maroon, dark green, gold and warm brown palette and consistent hair, face, costume, and seal props.
